astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: The Astrosphere of HD 61005
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Do young stars blow bubbles? The larger view shows a stellar field observed with the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory in Chile, and the inset highlights HD 61005, a star like our Sun, only 120 light-years away.
